note: Fall 2026 class routines of every BUBT programme on the trimester calendar, from the annex routine endpoint (13 programmes, among them Textile DH (024) and Civil DH (028), which no BUBT page links), retrieved 2026-10-16 UTC. A section is a programme's intake-section as the routine prints it ("59-1", "52-1 (Major: Finance)"), with spacing normalised; each record is one course in one intake-section, taught by one teacher. Meetings in consecutive slots of the same room are merged (a lab's two 90-minute slots become one meeting). Rooms are as printed: four digits, the first being the building. BUBT publishes no section sizes or seats, so capacity is null throughout. M.Sc CSE and MBA/EMBA are not here: their routines are PDFs only.
